notes: Waw plus explicit hu recast as a relative: Which realizes the pronoun, waw unrepresented (rule 17). Comparative kaf takes the copula (rule 49).

min to out of headed on out (rule 24); the competing reading gives coming out to yotse as in 19:4's gone out and leaves min a bare of. Either is defensible; the corpus-attested out of reading was retained.
